From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@novacare.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novacare.io>
Cc: Novacare Success <success@novacare.io>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novacare deployment stewardship & kickoff coordination

Team and Novacare — quick handoff note and a few asks to get us moving. Closing details: signed SOW (attached v3), 6-node dedicated pool reserved, 99.9% SLA start date target: 2026-11-01. High level context below; I put expected owners in parentheses but want confirmation.

Deal context / customer goals:
- Primary use: in-product intelligent search + summarization for care teams; ~15M tokens/month expected after ramp.
- Data sensitivity: PHI may be present in notes; customer requires SOC2 evidence and KMS for keys.

Recommended owner assignments (please confirm):
- Implementation lead: Vivek Kulkarni (runbook + infra onboarding)
- Customer Success: Marissa Cole (post-go-live adoption & QBRs)
- Ops escalation / capacity planning: Tessa Morgan

Immediate asks for internal team:
1) Confirm owners and update MAP_Novacare.xlsx (attached) with dates/assignees.
2) Vivek — can you schedule a 60-min kickoff with Novacare for next week? Use the Calendly link if helpful.
3) Tessa — note the special discount and 2-week pre-provisioning window (see contract). Flag any capacity risks.

Customer asks outstanding (from legal/procurement):
- Novacare asked for our data retention policy and longer SSO window; I copied Tom & Ellen.
- DocuSign is live: docusign_envelope_4821.pdf attached.

Attachments: Novacare_SOW_v3.pdf; MAP_Novacare.xlsx; docusign_envelope_4821.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on the first call if helpful.

—
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0191

Subject: Re: Novacare deployment stewardship & kickoff coordination

Thanks, Logan — great summary. Confirming owners: Marissa will be CS primary, Vivek will run implementation, Tessa will own ops/comms for provisioning windows. I updated the MAP_Novacare.xlsx with tentative milestones through week 6 (see attached).

Immediate next steps we own:
- Vivek: please propose 2 options for the kickoff (Mon/Tue next week) and include the standard kickoff agenda (I attached a refined agenda: kickoff_agenda_v2.docx).
- Marissa: I'll prepare the adoption plan draft and a first-30/60/90 milestone list for the customer.
- Tessa: share the capacity runbook with Logan and the SE team; note the SLA target and confirm whether 6-node dedicated is sufficient for the expected token volume.

Ellen/Tom — welcome. Can you confirm whether Novacare prefers SSO SAML or SCIM provisioning? Also, any calendar constraints for the week of Oct 11?

—
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Novacare deployment stewardship & kickoff coordination

Hi all — thanks for the clear plan. We can do Oct 12 at 10:00 PT. A couple of clarifications before kickoff:

1) Data retention: we plan to retain clinical notes for 7 years. Will the default Redwood retention settings conflict with that?
2) SSO: we currently use Okta via SAML; we'll need a SCIM connector for user provisioning. Can you share the integration checklist?

Also, we noticed the SOW calls out a 30-day trial for the analytics feature. Can you confirm whether that is included in the committed usage or considered an add-on?

Thanks — Ellen

Ellen — confirmed Oct 12 at 10:00 PT, invite sent. Quick answers: 
- Retention: we can support customer-configured retention up to 10 years; I'll attach the retention policy and mark the SOC2 artifacts.
- SSO/SCIM: we support SAML + SCIM; Vivek will send the integration checklist and provisioning steps during the kickoff.
- Analytics trial: the 30-day analytics trial is included at no extra charge during initial provisioning; post-trial usage will be billable per the SOW.

Attachments: Redwood_Data_Retention_Policy.pdf; SOC2_evidence_link.txt

Internal note: I have flagged the SOC2 evidence in the legal packet and shared the doc link in HubSpot. Marissa/Vivek — if anything blocks provisioning by Oct 10 call it out and I will escalate.

—
